scope_comparison: The September 2026 Theorem 1 announces strict speed decrease for the offspring law uniform on {2,3} only on lambda in [0,351/200]; it does not cover [0,2.5) for that law, much less every finite offspring law. The current Lyons–Peres book still asks general Question 17.33. Locally infinite offspring results are a different class.
